description:
Discover contemporary living at Grande Central/South Central, Rockbrook, Dublin 18

I-RES is delighted to introduce this superb development consisting of 1-bed/2-bed/3-bed apartments in the highly sought-after Grande Central/South Central development at Rockbrook, Sandyford, Dublin 18. Combining modern interiors, generous living space and excellent connectivity, this is an inviting home in one of South Dublin’s most convenient locations.

Apartment Features

Grande Central/South Central is a modern residential development set within beautifully landscaped surroundings, offering a selection of spacious 1-, 2- and 3-bedroom apartments.

Homes throughout the development are designed with bright, welcoming interiors and contemporary open-plan kitchen and living areas. Kitchens feature granite worktops, integrated appliances, private balconies.

Bedrooms are generously proportioned and include built-in or walk-in wardrobe space, depending on the apartment type. Homes also offer a combination of modern bathrooms and en-suite shower rooms, along with practical features such as utility areas, washer/dryer facilities and additional storage.

Layouts, features and specifications may vary between individual apartments.

Grande Central/South Central at Rockbrook offers the perfect balance of city convenience and comfortable neighbourhood living. Residents can enjoy an impressive choice of amenities just moments from home, including:

- Dunnes Stores
- Aldi
- Starbucks
- A wide selection of restaurants and takeaways
- FlyeFit
- Bank of Ireland
- Beacon Hospital

Dundrum Town Centre is approximately 3 km away and just five minutes by LUAS, offering an extensive selection of shops, restaurants, cafés and entertainment.

Families are also well catered for, with a number of primary and secondary schools nearby, together with Park Academy Crèche at Beacon South Quarter.

Getting around couldn’t be easier. Grande Central/South Central is exceptionally well connected by the LUAS Green Line and several bus routes serving Dublin City Centre and the surrounding area. The nearby M50 interchange also provides convenient access to Dublin Airport and beyond.


I-RES is a leading provider of professionally managed private residential rental accommodation in Ireland, with more than 3,600 homes across sustainable communities in Dublin.

As an I-RES resident, you can enjoy the reassurance of:

- Reliable, professional service when you need it
- Fully trained staff to support you throughout your tenancy
- A dedicated in-house maintenance team
- 24-hour emergency support for essential services, including loss of heat or water
- Clear communication and an accessible point of contact through our resident portal

Find out more at www.iresliving.ie

Enquiries and Viewings:

We aim to respond to enquiries as quickly as possible. Due to the high volume of interest we receive, however, we may not be able to reply individually to every enquiry. If you have not heard from us within 48 hours, we regret that we are unable to assist on this occasion.

Viewing is highly recommended. To register your interest, please complete the online enquiry form through www.daft.ie or www.iresliving.ie
